title: OpenArt launches Director, the first AI tool for real-time video vibe #openart #director #aivideo
description: OpenArt introduced Director, an AI tool that creates up to five minutes of continuous video from simple voice commands. It maintains consistent characters, voices, and styles across formats like live action, anime, and stop motion, with synced lip movements in multiple languages. Unlike other AI video tools that generate scattered clips, Director allows seamless editing by rebuilding scenes after timeline adjustments. This innovation simplifies complex video production, enabling creators to produce explainers, B-roll, and short films more efficiently. By enabling directorial control through conversation, Director advances the usability of AI in content creation, reducing manual effort and accelerating workflow for video professionals and enthusiasts. #OpenArt #DirectorAI #AIVideoCreation #VideoEditingAI #AIVideoTools #ContentCreationTech #AIAnimation #MultilingualAI #CreativeTech #Explainers #StopMotionAI #AnimeAI #VideoProduction #AIInnovation #VibeDirecting
